candidate_ideas.statement: Identify W_5 with omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D) for a divisor D in a balanced tetragonal g^1_4, thereby interpreting the marked divisor as residual to D in a canonical divisor, with the correct Casnati-Ekedahl convention and signs.

Construct the rank-drop/evaluation-failure locus Z over the moduli of balanced tetragonal structures as the reduced-support open of the relative linear system |W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}|, followed by the finite etale ordering cover, after comparing scheme structures with a relative Abel-Jacobi incidence space.

Stratify the relative degree-six linear system by h^0(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}) and determine every stratum's components, dimensions, stabilizers, and maps to tetragonal moduli, including hyperelliptic, trigonal, nonreduced-support, and other special loci.
For a free tetragonal pencil D with h^0(O_C(D))=2, Riemann-Roch gives h^0(omega_C(-D))=3 and hence a P^2-family of residual degree-six divisors.
The numerical package dim(Hurwitz)=15, dim(Z)=17, and codim_{M_{6,6}}(Z)=4 describes the relevant incidence geometry of the residual locus.

Use localization and Gysin maps, with correct degree, weight, and Tate-twist conventions and controlled differentials, to isolate the exact contributions of the rank-drop locus to Gr^W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q).
Reduce the lowest-weight cohomology of all relevant strata and coefficient systems to explicitly controlled configuration or Hurwitz spaces whose monodromy is under control.

Prove that every exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the rank-drop locus is a sum of Q(-13), and assemble that contribution with the complementary open contribution into the exact lowest-weight target.
W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) equals the image of H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6};Q) under restriction and is a direct sum of Q(-13); equivalently W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a direct sum of Q(8).
The Casnati-Ekedahl resolution computes the exact lowest-weight degree-26 contribution on the complementary open locus away from the residual failure locus.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001 (mechanically_verified; cases: all).
established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q), identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d).
For (g,n)=(6,6), d=3*6-3+6=21 and the ordinary cohomological degree corresponding to the Borel-Moore target is 2d-16=26.

established_facts.evidence: Dimension formula 3g-3+n with (g,n)=(6,6) yields 18-3+6=21; smoothness of the moduli DM stack is standard.
established_facts.statement: The stack M_{6,6} is smooth of complex dimension 21.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 degree/Serre-duality calculation, including the negative sign in gamma^*O(-f).
established_facts.statement: With W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P1}(-f))|_C, one has deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f.
For g=6 and f=5, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1})=6.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 obstruction-degree formula 4f+n-2g-14 with n=6,g=6 and f=5,4.
established_facts.statement: For a marked divisor Gamma of degree six, deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma))=4*5+6-2*6-14=0, whereas deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=4*4+6-2*6-14=-4.

established_facts.evidence: The defining line bundle has degree -4; a line bundle of negative degree on a smooth projective curve has no nonzero global section.
established_facts.statement: The f=4 obstruction space H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) vanishes for every ordered reduced degree-six divisor Gamma.

established_facts.evidence: The obstruction line bundle has degree zero; a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: For the f=5 summand, H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) is nonzero if and only if O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.
For L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, chi(L)=1 and h^0(L)>=1 on every smooth geometric fibre.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0035 (corroborated; residual list; coefficients Q).
established_facts.statement: For the RED-0001 residual list over Q, the required ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,2) and equals vcd-1 for (8,0),(8,1); it never exceeds vcd, so vanishing-above-vcd proves none of the seven cases.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0036 (mechanically_verified; degree 26; map M_{6,6} to M_{6,5}).
established_facts.statement: For the forgetful map M_{6,6}->M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in q=0,1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

established_facts.evidence: Packet canonical geometric bottleneck: reduced-support open and finite etale S_6-cover; do not call that open locus closed.
established_facts.statement: The locus of reduced degree-six divisors with six distinct support points in a relative linear system is open, and ordering the six support points defines a finite etale S_6-cover of that reduced-support open.

established_facts.evidence: Standard edge-image statement from Deligne's weight spectral sequence for the logarithmic de Rham complex: E_1^{-p,k+p}=H^{k-p}(D^{[p]};Q)(-p) has p=0 term H^k(\bar X;Q) and p>0 terms of weight k+p>k.
established_facts.statement: For a smooth variety or smooth Deligne-Mumford stack X with a smooth proper snc compactification \bar X, the lowest-weight piece satisfies W_k H^k(X;Q)=im(j^*:H^k(\bar X;Q)->H^k(X;Q)).

established_facts.evidence: Fixed target dictionary: dimension/poincare_twist 21, ordinary weight/degree 26, ordinary Tate type Q(-13), open BM Tate type Q(8); twist computation -13+21=8.
established_facts.statement: Poincare duality for the smooth 21-dimensional stack M_{6,6} identifies W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) with W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), and the Tate-twist arithmetic Q(-13)(21)=Q(8) holds.

established_facts.evidence: Packet canonical geometric bottleneck CE line-bundle convention and balanced tetragonal splitting.
established_facts.statement: CE line-bundle convention: W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P1}(-5))|_C is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C and is not the O_{P1}(5) summand of the balanced tetragonal splitting F=O_{P1}(4) direct-sum O_{P1}(5).

invalid_steps.statement: Infer that an arbitrary finite etale cover of a space with pure-Tate cohomology also has pure-Tate cohomology.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finiteness alone gives no control on the new cohomology or monodromy of the covering space.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer that being finite over an open subset of M_{0,b} is sufficient to make every lowest-weight cohomology group of a Hurwitz space Tate.

invalid_steps.statement: Infer that the h^0-stratification of a degree-six line bundle L with chi(L)=1 can contain an r=0 stratum.

invalid_steps.statement: Infer that every non-Tate geometric variation necessarily has weight at least one.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: A proof of the identification W_5 isomorphic to omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), with the correct Casnati-Ekedahl convention and signs, is required.
The balanced tetragonal moduli space, its components, dimension, splitting-type locus, and forgetful map to M_6 require rigorous construction and verification.

Construct a relative effective-divisor or Abel-Jacobi incidence space compatible with arbitrary base change when h^0(L) jumps, and compare its Fitting/determinantal scheme structure with the CE evaluation-failure locus.

Every h^0-stratum of the relative degree-six linear system requires a complete component and dimension analysis, including hyperelliptic, trigonal, nonreduced-support, and other special loci, together with stabilizers and finite-cover behavior.
The exact cohomology and monodromy of the relevant Hurwitz covers and finite ordering covers must be controlled; Tate cohomology cannot be inferred merely from finiteness over M_{0,b}.
The Casnati-Ekedahl resolution must be shown to compute the exact lowest-weight degree-26 contribution on the complementary open locus.

The localization or Gysin spectral sequence for the chosen stratification must be constructed with correct degree, weight, and Tate-twist conventions, and all relevant differentials must be controlled; Aut(Gamma)-invariants versus coinvariants must be tracked.
Weight-zero nonconstant local systems and finite-monodromy representations on every contributing stratum require explicit analysis.

Tate type for the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the rank-drop locus remains to be proved, and its assembly with the complementary open contribution in Gr^W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) remains to be justified.

Independent control of Hodge numbers of H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6};Q) and of which pure weight-26 classes die under restriction to M_{6,6} is required before any pure-Tate conclusion for the lowest-weight edge image.
